run_train_and_evaluate: run the train_and_evaluate function to train a Neural Neighbourhood Search model with distributed strategy
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point to start Neural LNS training with config from neural_lns/config_train.py
create_model_light_gnn: create a light_gnn model using get_model with model config params for graph-based neural network
build_training_step: build a training step function that computes gradients, applies Adam optimizer, and tracks accuracy metrics
build_evaluation_step: build an evaluation step function that computes validation loss and tracks AUC and accuracy metrics
